voice.brief-nature-mix: Let's find three nature treasures. Look closely, listen carefully, and take your time.
voice.brief-texture-trail: Let's find three textures. Touch gently, and ask a grown-up before you pick anything up.
voice.brief-color-quest: Let's find three colors in nature. Even a tiny spot of color counts.
voice.brief-ready: Here are your three clues. Tap the big green button when you're ready.
voice.clue-smooth: Find something smooth. Gently feel its surface.
voice.clue-green: Find something green. Look closely. The tiniest bit of green counts.
voice.clue-round: Find something round. It can be a berry, a pebble, or your own idea.
voice.clue-tiny: Find something tiny. Use your sharp explorer eyes.
voice.clue-sound: Find something that makes a gentle sound when you move it. Listen carefully.
voice.clue-long: Find something long. Compare it with your hand.
voice.clue-bumpy: Find something bumpy. Feel each little bump.
voice.clue-soft: Find something soft. Touch it very gently.
voice.clue-rough: Find something rough. Rub one finger across it.
voice.clue-bendy: Find something bendy. Ask a grown-up before you bend it.
voice.clue-tickly: Find something tickly. Brush it softly on your hand.
voice.clue-red: Find something red. A little spot of red counts.
voice.clue-orange: Find something orange. Look near flowers, leaves, or your own idea.
voice.clue-brown: Find something brown. Look near the ground and on tree bark.
voice.clue-blue: Find something blue. Look up, look down, and look for a tiny patch.
voice.clue-golden: Find something golden yellow. A seed, a flower, or your own idea can count.
voice.praise-3: You found a real nature clue!
voice.complete-nature-mix: Nature Mix complete! You used your eyes, ears, and hands.
voice.complete-texture-trail: Texture Trail complete! Your fingertips notice so much!
voice.complete-color-quest: Color Quest complete! You found a rainbow outside.
